e: Independent fellowship at STScI for research combining data science (large databases, ML, statistics, image processing) with astronomy, astrophysics or planetary science. PhD in astronomy, physics or related field by start; no citizenship limits stated.
n: STScI: Barry M. Lasker Data Science Postdoctoral Fellowship 2027
unv: STScI Lasker page (Oct 12, 2026) confirmed the Oct 29, 2026 deadline and lists only a "competitive salary"; the $84,875/yr figure is from the AAS ad. On Oct 26, 2026 the STScI page was unreachable (TLS error, HTTP 503), the AAS ad returned HTTP 403 and the SlideRoom form shows no text without JavaScript, so the deadline was not re-verified.
